hook: Wesley So won a match with a losing position.

sections.voiceover: How did Grandmaster Wesley So win with an inferior position against Grandmaster Jeffery Xiong?

text_overlay.text: Wesley So won a match with a losing position

sections.voiceover: With an Elo rating of 2770, Grandmaster Wesley So played against the 2656 opponent.
Chess publications noted that Grandmaster Wesley So was much worse before finding a tactical turnaround.
Grandmaster Wesley So executed a tactical turnaround after move 21...Nxf4 in Saint Louis. Grandmaster Wesley So achieved a 2/2 score matching Awonder Liang.
Grandmaster Wesley So secured the 2/2 score in Saint Louis.
